flows.title: Homepage
flows.summary: The /markets homepage: depth book hero, sample answers, the Split sections, and the nav per state (signed out, waitlist, signed in). Sign up opens the sheet.

states.label: Signed out
states.note: The final homepage. Sign up and Sign in open the sheet.

states.label: Waitlist
states.note: Sign up becomes Join waitlist.

states.label: Signed in
states.note: Nav shows Open chat; a Continue strip.

Start the tour → after a new sign-up with a homepage question
Open chat → after a returning sign-in, or when signed in
Watching card when signed in

events.name: signed-in
events.when: The code was right; the sheet shows the next step

flows.title: Sign up
flows.summary: The email and six-digit code sheet, including send, recovery and returning-account states. The demo code changes after resend.

states.label: Email
states.note: Make an account, email field.

states.label: Invalid email
states.note: Shows how to correct the address before requesting a code.

states.label: Sending code
states.note: The button shows progress and prevents a second request.

states.label: Send failed
states.note: Try again with the address already in the field.

states.label: Code sent
states.note: Six boxes, a still of the email. 417302 works.

states.label: Wrong code
states.note: Red line, boxes clear.

states.label: Code expired
states.note: The old code is disabled. Send a new code to continue.

states.label: Code resent
states.note: Confirms the new code and restarts the cooldown.

states.label: Resume signup
states.note: After a refresh, continue with the code already sent.

states.label: Returning
states.note: Welcome back. Skips the tour.

states.label: Existing account verified
states.note: An existing account entered through Sign up. Open chat skips the tour.

states.label: Returning with a question
states.note: The question stays with the user after sign-in and opens as a draft in chat.

exits.on: Start the tour → (new account)
Open chat → (returning)
Open chat with a waiting question

flows.title: The tour
flows.summary: A new account's full-screen intro: three screens with live demos and a "What do you trade?" pick, ending on Connect Kite.

states.label: New account
states.note: Full-screen intro, screen 1 of 3.

states.label: With a question
states.note: The homepage question stays visible on all three screens.

states.label: In the app
states.note: The chat behind the Kite gate, after Not now.

states.label: Kite skipped, question saved
states.note: Chat shows the saved question. Connect Kite later to run it.

exits.on: Connect Kite on the last screen, the gate banner or the sidebar link

flows.title: Connect Kite
flows.summary: The Connect Kite dialog over the gated chat, with a login preview, safety FAQ, waiting, failed and connected. Success opens chat with a waiting question if there is one.

states.label: Connect
states.note: Summary left; a three-step preview of Kite's login right.

states.label: Is it safe?
states.note: The FAQ.

states.label: Waiting
states.note: Kite's window is open.

states.label: Didn't connect
states.note: The window closed before login finished.

states.label: Kite window blocked
states.note: Allow pop-ups, then retry. The question still waits.

states.label: Kite login timed out
states.note: Start a fresh Kite login after the countdown. The question still waits.

states.label: Connected
states.note: Ring fills, then chat opens. A waiting question runs only if the user entered or chose one.

exits.on: Kite connects with a question saved during onboarding or chosen in the gated chat
Kite connects without a question
Open Watchers on a started watcher
Trade on Kite under the answer
Tap your account row (bottom left)

events.name: connected
events.when: Kite connected and the gate lifted

flows.title: First question
flows.summary: A question runs: status line, a plan that ticks off, Answer · Chart · Code, sources, receipt, next actions. Watch this prefills a watcher prompt and a confirm card. Interrupted answers, missing data, credits and chat-length limits.

states.label: Empty
states.note: A new chat.

states.label: Question kept after sign-in
states.note: The original question is in the chat box, ready to edit or send.

states.label: Running
states.note: Held inside the plan.

states.label: Answer
states.note: Later version: if a stock or contract is ambiguous, ask the user which one they meant before running the answer.

states.label: Stopped
states.note: Stopped part-way. Nothing more ran.

states.label: Answer timed out
states.note: Try the same question again in this chat.

states.label: Kite expired mid-answer
states.note: The partial answer stays in chat. Reconnect Kite to retry the same question.

states.label: No market data found
states.note: No candles for the requested date. Edit the original question.

states.label: Credits low
states.note: 20% left.

states.label: Credits out
states.note: The limit card.

states.label: Long chat
states.note: A nudge to start a new chat.

states.label: Chat full
states.note: A new chat with a carried summary.

flows.title: Watchers
flows.summary: The Watchers screen (E · Simple): no watchers, just started, alerted, finished, Kite ended, plus the alert email and the 8 AM reminder email.

states.label: No watchers
states.note: Empty screen with three example prompts.

states.label: Just started
states.note: The watcher from the first question, just started.

states.label: Alerted
states.note: GOLDBEES is true now; the log shows what was sent.

states.label: Finished
states.note: Expired and cancelled.

states.label: Kite ended
states.note: Later version: when Kite reconnects, only resume watchers paused by Kite expiry. Keep manually paused watchers paused.

states.label: Alert email
states.note: The email when GOLDBEES dropped below 100.

states.label: Reminder email
states.note: The 8 AM email when watchers are paused.

flows.title: Your account
flows.summary: The account pop-up from the avatar: email, a Kite reconnect hero (Kite ends at 6 AM daily), token use as one bar split into chats and watchers, Use in Claude or ChatGPT, Sign out.

states.label: Reconnecting
states.note: Waiting on Kite.

states.label: Reconnect failed

states.label: Connected
states.note: Countdown to 6 AM.

states.label: Disconnected
states.note: Disconnected by you.
